meta.scope: UAE Batch 6 — Promote previously deferred high-value topics using proposed: domain tags: oil production, tourism, ports/logistics, dual-emirate framing. Evidence standard still applied to dependencies.

reports.title: Crude oil and condensate production and export statistics
reports.publisher: ADNOC / energy monitoring (compiled from official and industry sources)
reports.description: Statistics on crude oil and condensate production and export volumes. Production is concentrated in Abu Dhabi; export volumes are large and respond to OPEC+ and market conditions. Hydrocarbons remain a core contributor to the current account and fiscal position.

reports.title: Dubai overnight visitor arrivals and tourism performance
reports.publisher: Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism
reports.description: Official statistics on overnight visitor arrivals to Dubai and related tourism performance indicators (occupancy, source markets). Dubai is the dominant tourism destination within the UAE.

reports.title: Jebel Ali and UAE ports container throughput
reports.description: Container and cargo throughput statistics centred on Jebel Ali Port. The UAE is a major global transshipment and logistics node; throughput is a key indicator of the non-oil trade and logistics economy.

reports.title: Dubai non-oil services and logistics hub framing
reports.publisher: Derived from FCSC and Dubai official sources
reports.description: Analytical framing of Dubai as the principal non-oil services, logistics, tourism and finance hub within the UAE federation.

reports.title: Abu Dhabi hydrocarbon and sovereign-wealth hub framing
reports.publisher: Derived from FCSC and Abu Dhabi official sources
reports.description: Analytical framing of Abu Dhabi as the principal hydrocarbon producer, sovereign-wealth centre and federal capital.

_dropped.why: Oil is a major component of GDP, but no FCSC or ADNOC methodological document located in this pass that explicitly states the data dependency with a quotable claim linking the production series to the national accounts release.
Tourism contributes to services GDP, but no document was found that states a concrete statistical dependency with a direct quote.
Port throughput is a leading indicator of trade activity, but no official document was located that asserts a formal data dependency.
Emirate-level economic structure is widely understood to sum into federal GDP, but no single document with a quotable methodological claim was retrieved in this pass.

_dropped.edge: sovereign wealth funds (ADIA/Mubadala) as standalone nodes
_dropped.why: ADIA and Mubadala are high-centrality. They fit poorly under existing domains (closest would be proposed:investment). Left for a dedicated pass once proposed:investment or similar is confirmed acceptable.
